pricingPage.faqQ1: Can I change plans at any time?
pricingPage.faqA1: You can request changes at any time. Upgrades apply once the new charge is confirmed, with proration of the time already paid; downgrades are scheduled for the next period.
pricingPage.faqQ2: What happens when my trial ends?
pricingPage.faqA2: When the trial ends, review the available activation options and plans in your dashboard.
pricingPage.faqA3: Not from us: AI limits do not trigger automatic overage charges; once reached, that automation pauses and upgrade options are shown. There are charges outside the plan that are not ours: from 1 October 2026, Meta bills your own WhatsApp Business account for the messages it delivers — service messages, and also marketing, utility and authentication templates — with the payment method you add on Meta. Third-party services or optional packages are quoted separately.
pricingPage.faqQ4: Do you accept local currency payments?
pricingPage.faqA4: In Colombia, subscriptions are charged in COP through Wompi. In other supported countries, they are charged in USD through Stripe. Confirm your country to see the applicable price before checkout.
pricingPage.faqQ5: Is there an annual payment discount?
pricingPage.faqA5: When annual billing is available, its full price is shown before checkout. If it saves money versus twelve monthly payments, the percentage is shown too; the annual total is charged upfront.
pricingPage.faqA6: Plan changes and cancellation are managed through the options available in your billing dashboard.
pricingPage.faqQ7: How are charges and refunds handled?
pricingPage.faqA7: Billing shows the history and status of each payment. Any refund is governed by the current terms.
pricingPage.faqQ8: Does the Custom plan have a fixed price?
pricingPage.faqA8: No, it's quoted based on your volume, number of agents and special requirements. Contact us for a proposal.
pricingPage.faqQ9: Does the plan include what Meta charges for WhatsApp?
pricingPage.faqA9: No: they are two separate payments. The plan pays for Parallly’s software. From 1 October 2026, Meta bills your own WhatsApp Business account for the messages it delivers on that number: service messages — your replies inside the 24-hour window — and also marketing, utility and authentication templates, such as a campaign, an appointment reminder or a verification code. That money never passes through Parallly: it is paid with the payment method you add in Meta’s tools. Each number gets 1,000 free service messages per calendar month, and that allowance does not cover templates. The rate is published by Meta and varies with the recipient’s country and the message category: a marketing template costs considerably more than a service message. If that account is left without a valid payment method, WhatsApp stops delivering service messages. Instagram, Messenger and Telegram have no per-service-message charge from their provider today.

faq.subtitle: Clear answers before taking the next step.
faq.q1: Do I need to know how to code?
faq.a1: You can prepare the agent from the dashboard: business information, role, rules and tools. Parallly Assist explains what to configure and where. Each channel has its own connection requirements; web chat requires adding the widget to your site.
faq.a2: You configure business information, your catalog, FAQs and rules. AI consults those sources to prepare its replies. You can test them, adjust instructions and decide when your team should step in.
faq.q3: Is it secure? What about my data?
faq.a3: Each business has isolated data and access protected by authentication and roles. Wompi in Colombia and Stripe outside Colombia processes subscription payments. See the privacy policy for details on data handling.
faq.q4: How do I stay in control of the AI?
faq.a4: You define its sources, instructions and the cases it should pass to a person. Before publishing, you can test and review its replies. If a customer requests a person or a handoff rule is triggered, the conversation goes to the team with context, provided human support is enabled. AI needs supervision and can make mistakes.
faq.a5: You can work step by step with guidance from Parallly Assist: prepare content, choose tools, connect the channel and test. Timing depends on your sources, channel requirements and reviews before publishing.
faq.q6: Does it work in my country?
faq.a6: Select your country in the pricing section to see available currencies and terms. Channel and payment-method availability depends on the country, provider and plan.
faq.q7: Can I change or cancel my plan?
faq.a7: You can manage the available options in billing. The effective date and terms are shown before confirming a change.
faq.q8: Does it integrate with my current system?
faq.a8: Parallly includes its own CRM and calendar connections. It also offers data exchange options depending on your plan. If you rely on another tool, check that specific integration before subscribing.
faq.ctaText: Have another question? Write to us on WhatsApp.
faq.q9: What if my business is not listed?
faq.a9: Industries are starting points. Explore processes such as answering inquiries, following up on sales, booking appointments or working with your team. Configure your sources, tools and rules; if you need a specialized process, we review its scope before assuming coverage.
faq.q10: Do Parallly Assist and my AI agent do the same thing?
faq.a10: Your AI agent serves customers using the information and tools you enable. Parallly Assist helps your team use and configure the platform according to their role. The Quality Center lets you review readiness, tests and production signals to guide improvements.

whatsappCosts.heroTitle: Who charges you what when you sell on WhatsApp
whatsappCosts.heroSubtitle: There are three separate charges and only one of them is ours. Here is each one: who issues it, where it is set up, and what we cannot promise you about it.
whatsappCosts.heroReviewed: This page was last reviewed on 10 September 2026.
whatsappCosts.heroReviewedNote: WhatsApp's rules and rates are published by Meta and can change. The link to its official page is below.
whatsappCosts.ruleIntro: From 1 October 2026, Meta charges for every message it delivers from your WhatsApp Business number. The charge goes to your own WhatsApp Business account, using the payment method you added in Meta's tools.
whatsappCosts.allowanceBody: Each number gets 1,000 free service messages per calendar month. They do not roll over to the next month, they are not multiplied per country, and they do not cover templates.
whatsappCosts.categoriesIntro: A message incurs the charge for its own category. Naming only one of them would give a misleading idea of the total.
whatsappCosts.categoryService: Service — your replies inside the 24-hour window, whether a person or the agent writes them. This is the category the free allowance covers.
whatsappCosts.categoryMarketing: Marketing — promotions and campaigns. It is the most expensive category in every market we sell into.
whatsappCosts.categoryUtility: Utility — appointment reminders, order confirmations and notices. From October these are charged inside the 24-hour window too.
whatsappCosts.countryTitle: The recipient's country sets the rate
whatsappCosts.countryBody: Not your company's country. The same number can pay very different rates depending on where it writes to, which is why there is no single per-message price.
whatsappCosts.deadlineBody: Meta asks for a payment method on the account before 30 September 2026. Without one, from 1 October 2026 that account stops delivering service messages. The connection still exists; what stops is delivery.
whatsappCosts.setupTitle: How Meta billing is set up
whatsappCosts.setupIntro: Connecting the number and adding the payment method are two different steps. The first ends in Parallly; the second happens on an official Meta page.
whatsappCosts.setupStep1Body: You complete the official Meta window that Parallly opens, and come back. That connects the number: it does not set up billing.
whatsappCosts.setupStep2Title: Check who pays for that account
whatsappCosts.setupStep2Body: Parallly shows you the number, the account that funds its messages and the billing mode. If a payment method is already attached, we do not ask for another.
whatsappCosts.setupStep3Body: Meta's WhatsApp management opens in another tab. There you pick the account, go into payment settings and add the method. Whoever does it needs admin permissions on that account at Meta: a Parallly role does not grant them.
whatsappCosts.setupStep4Body: When you return, Parallly re-reads the status Meta reports and shows you the date of that reading. It is a status check: it does not make a charge or send a test message.
whatsappCosts.setupStep5Body: “Method attached” means Meta reports a card on the account. It does not confirm available funds, the absence of restrictions, or that the next message will be delivered.
whatsappCosts.setupExternalNotice: The link opens an external Meta site in a new tab.
whatsappCosts.securityTitle: What Parallly does not do with that card
whatsappCosts.security1: It does not receive the number or the security code of the card you add at Meta. Those details are typed on Meta's page.
whatsappCosts.security2: It does not store it, copy it or verify it. It only reads the status Meta exposes with the permissions you authorised.
whatsappCosts.security3: It never asks for that card's details in chat, by email or inside the assistant. If someone does that in Parallly's name, it is not us.
whatsappCosts.securityNote: Your subscription card and your Meta card can be the same physical card, but they are two independent records. Changing or removing one does not change the other.
whatsappCosts.limitsTitle: What this page does not promise
whatsappCosts.limits1: Messages sent from Parallly — by the agent, by your team, by reminders and by campaigns — can incur Meta charges. Us not holding your card does not make sending free.
whatsappCosts.limits2: If other apps send from the same WhatsApp Business account, that usage is billed there too and is not under our control.
whatsappCosts.limits3: Cancelling your Parallly subscription, disconnecting the channel and removing Meta's payment method are three different acts. None of them performs another.
whatsappCosts.otherChannelsBody: Instagram, Messenger, Telegram and Web Chat have no per-service-message charge from their provider today. They still need a plan where that channel is available and a connected account, and this says nothing about how they will be priced in the future.
whatsappCosts.faqQ1: Who pays Meta for my WhatsApp messages?
whatsappCosts.faqA1: Your business does. Meta issues the charge against your own WhatsApp Business account, using the payment method you add there. That money never passes through Parallly and is not part of your plan.
whatsappCosts.faqQ2: Can my subscription card pay Meta?
whatsappCosts.faqA2: No. Wompi in Colombia and Stripe outside Colombia only processes your Parallly subscription. Meta’s payment method is configured and held by Meta. Payments from your customers use your business’s own credentials.
whatsappCosts.faqQ3: Do the 1,000 free messages include the AI's replies?
whatsappCosts.faqA3: Yes, when they are service messages: Meta counts by category, not by who wrote them. It is 1,000 service deliveries per number per calendar month; they do not cover templates, do not roll over, and are not an allowance per country.
whatsappCosts.faqQ4: What happens if that account has no payment method?
whatsappCosts.faqA4: From 1 October 2026, an account without a valid payment method stops delivering service messages. Meta asks for one before 30 September 2026.
whatsappCosts.faqQ5: Can you tell me how much I will spend at Meta?
whatsappCosts.faqA5: Not honestly. It depends on each recipient's country, each message's category and how many are delivered. Meta publishes the rates and bills the real usage; this page tells you where to look them up.
whatsappCosts.ctaTitle: Now you know who charges what
whatsappCosts.ctaBody: Parallly's price and current terms are on the plans page. Meta's charge is separate and is set up at Meta.
whatsappCosts.ratesSourceBody: The estimator's rates are derived from the official cards Meta published, preserved with a verification fingerprint. Under the result you will find the exact card, the date it takes effect and the file the numbers were read from. Meta revises those cards periodically: when one changes, this page changes with it, because the figures here are not typed in by hand.
whatsappCosts.estimateNotInvoiceTitle: An estimate is not an invoice
whatsappCosts.estimateNotInvoiceBody: The total comes from the volumes you enter and from the card in force for the market you pick. Your real consumption is measured and billed by Meta on your own account, against the messages actually delivered and the countries you actually write to. Use it to budget an order of magnitude, not to expect that exact amount.
whatsappCosts.estimatorTitle: Work out what Meta would charge you
whatsappCosts.estimatorIntro: Pick the country of the people receiving your messages, how many you deliver per month and how many numbers you have. The estimator subtracts the free allowance and applies the rate card that governs. Nothing leaves your browser: we ask for no personal data and make no real lookup.
whatsappCosts.estimatorStateBeforeTitle: Meta does not charge for service messages yet
whatsappCosts.estimatorStateBeforeBody: The card in force today publishes no service rate at all. What you see below is the rule that begins on 1 October 2026, worked out with the card that takes effect that day.
whatsappCosts.estimatorStateActiveTitle: Meta now charges for service messages
whatsappCosts.estimatorStateActiveBody: The calculation uses the card in force for the account currency you pick. A card changes over at midnight in your WhatsApp Business account's time zone, not in yours.
whatsappCosts.estimatorMarketHint: Meta charges by the recipient's country, not by your company's. The names are the ones on its own card. The regions group countries Meta does not list one by one, and it assigns each country to a region by calling code on a page that is not part of these cards: that is why you pick the market instead of us deducing it from a number.
whatsappCosts.estimatorCurrencyHint: This is the currency Meta bills the business's account in. It changes neither the recipient's country nor the rate that applies to it.
whatsappCosts.estimatorNumbersHint: The free allowance is per number and per calendar month. More numbers means more free allowance, and a charge of its own for each one.
whatsappCosts.estimatorVolumeLegend: Messages delivered per month, by category
whatsappCosts.estimatorNotInvoice: This is an estimate, not an invoice.
whatsappCosts.estimatorUnpricedNote: A category with no published rate is not a free category: it is a price the card does not establish. While one remains, the total shows as incomplete rather than as if it were smaller.
whatsappCosts.estimatorAllowanceNote: Free service deliveries have been subtracted: {deliveries} per number and per calendar month, which do not roll over into the next month and do not cover templates.
whatsappCosts.estimatorMixNote: If you write to more than one country, this estimate covers only the market you picked, and the free allowance is subtracted once in total: it is not repeated per country.
whatsappCosts.estimatorRoundingNote: Meta bills in whole units of the currency and rounds up. The same rounding is applied here, once, over the total.
whatsappCosts.estimatorExclusionsTitle: What this estimate does not include
whatsappCosts.estimatorExclusion1: Your Parallly subscription, which is billed separately and does not depend on how many messages you deliver.
whatsappCosts.estimatorExclusion2: Whatever other applications connected to the same WhatsApp Business account bill Meta for.
whatsappCosts.estimatorExclusion3: Utility and authentication volume tiers, which Meta applies per tier and not retroactively across every message.
whatsappCosts.estimatorExclusion4: Taxes, your bank's charges and any particular condition of your own account with Meta.

compareMeta.heroSubtitle: Meta has its own AI business agent, and it does several of the things we do well. This page compares task by task, says where every fact came from, and admits what we could not verify.
compareMeta.heroDate: Sources consulted on 10 September 2026. This comparison is reviewed before 10 December 2026.
compareMeta.method1: Public primary sources from Meta only: its product pages, its developer documentation and its help centre. Every row links its own.
compareMeta.method2: We did not activate Meta's agent, did not sign in to any account, did not send messages and did not generate charges.
compareMeta.method3: What it says about Parallly comes from the product's own state: implemented capability, not yet certified. There is not one row where we call ourselves certified.
compareMeta.method4: “We found no public documentation” describes the result of our search, not Meta's product. It does not mean Meta cannot do it.
compareMeta.methodLimit1: No benchmark has been run against an eligible Meta account, so we do not compare quality, speed or outcomes.
compareMeta.methodLimit2: Meta's availability varies by country, account and language. A feature missing from one account does not prove it is missing from another.
compareMeta.methodLimit3: That is why you will not read here that we are better, cheaper or faster: we have nothing to back it with.
compareMeta.surfacesTitle: Three Meta products that are not the same thing
compareMeta.surfacesIntro: Mixing them up is the most common error in these comparisons. They have different capabilities, terms and prices.
compareMeta.surfaceAppAgentTitle: The agent inside the WhatsApp Business app
compareMeta.surfaceAppAgentBody: The one a business turns on from its phone. It learns from its chats, its Page, its website and its catalogue; it accepts tone instructions; it connects Google Calendar and Google Drive; and it alerts the person when needed.
compareMeta.surfacePlatformApiBody: The enterprise offering on top of Cloud API: connectors to systems, skills, events and measurement. Its WhatsApp scope excludes the WhatsApp Business app, and its eligibility excludes several business categories.
compareMeta.surfaceOwnerAssistantTitle: Meta AI for the business owner
compareMeta.surfaceOwnerAssistantBody: It helps the owner prepare content, campaigns and analysis. It is not the agent that serves your customers, and its permissions do not transfer to it.
compareMeta.tableIntro: Every row compares the native agent inside the WhatsApp Business app, except where another surface is named.
compareMeta.tableCaption: Task-by-task comparison between Parallly and Meta's business agent, with each side's evidence state and its sources
compareMeta.verdictNativeMayBeEnough: The native option may be enough
compareMeta.taskKnowledgeParallly: Catalogue, FAQs, policies, business information and documents: the agent retrieves them on every turn. Implemented capability, not yet certified.
compareMeta.taskKnowledgeMeta: Meta documents that its agent learns from previous chats, the Facebook Page, the website and the catalogue, and that the business can add documents, photos and price lists.
compareMeta.taskToneLabel: Setting the tone and correcting an answer
compareMeta.taskToneParallly: One persona per connection, business rules and a three-layer prompt contract. It is rehearsed before publishing. Implemented, not certified.
compareMeta.taskToneMeta: Meta documents tone instructions, rehearsal as a customer and rewriting answers both in testing and live, plus editing or deleting what was learned.
compareMeta.taskBookingParallly: Its own booking engine with services, staff and per-resource capacity, plus reminders. Implemented, not certified.
compareMeta.taskBookingMeta: Meta documents that the agent books once Google Calendar is connected from the phone. Its help does not describe the behaviour with several calendars, with staff, or with two customers asking for the same slot.
compareMeta.taskHandoffLabel: Handing the conversation to a person
compareMeta.taskHandoffParallly: A team inbox carrying the conversation's context, assignment and roles; the agent stops while the person is handling it. Implemented, not certified.
compareMeta.taskHandoffMeta: Meta documents that replying from the phone stops the AI's answers until it is reactivated, that it notifies when attention is needed, and that escalation topics can be defined.
compareMeta.taskFollowUpLabel: Following up before the customer writes
compareMeta.taskFollowUpParallly: Reminders, notices and campaigns come from registered policies, each with its authorisation and its record. Implemented, not certified.
compareMeta.taskFollowUpMeta: An official case study published by Meta describes follow-up when a customer stops replying. That is the evidence of one case, not a specification of what every account does.
compareMeta.taskCustomerPaymentsParallly: The payment link uses the provider your business configures, and the money lands in your account. Implemented, not certified.
compareMeta.taskCustomerPaymentsMeta: The agent's payments help page only exposed availability for selected businesses in India and Brazil. We could not verify the flow, the fees or availability in Colombia.
compareMeta.taskChannelsLabel: Serving customers on more than one channel
compareMeta.taskChannelsParallly: Five self-service channels — WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram and Web Chat — with a single conversation per contact. None has completed certification yet.
compareMeta.taskChannelsMeta: The agent's official scope includes WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram, with availability by country and account. We found no primary evidence of a web widget or Telegram; that does not prove they do not exist.
compareMeta.taskOperationLabel: Leaving a record in the CRM and the operation
compareMeta.taskOperationParallly: CRM included: contact, pipeline, notes, attributes and automations, fed by the conversation itself. Implemented, not certified.
compareMeta.taskOperationMeta: The WhatsApp Business app has labels and a catalogue, and Meta Business Suite has an inbox and management tools. Saying Meta does not organise customers would be false; what we found no documentation for is the agent writing into those tools.
compareMeta.taskLearningControlLabel: Controlling what is learned and what is shared
compareMeta.taskLearningControlParallly: What the agent learns keeps its origin and purpose, and publishing or rolling back reaches the derived material. Parallly uses AI providers to generate answers: the scope is in the privacy policy.
compareMeta.taskLearningControlMeta: Meta documents that, while the agent is active, it keeps receiving messages from connected chats to improve its AI, and that removing the agent stops that future sharing. Muting it is not the same as removing it.
compareMeta.taskCostParallly: A subscription published in the plan catalogue, plus whatever Meta bills your own WhatsApp Business account for delivered messages. Two charges, both visible.
compareMeta.taskCostMeta: Meta announced that starting with its native agent is free and anticipated paid subscriptions later, without publishing a price or a date. Its enterprise API does have a published price, but it is a different product and not the app's rate.
compareMeta.nativeEnoughTitle: When Meta's agent is probably enough for you
compareMeta.nativeEnoughIntro: A comparison that never concedes anything is an advertisement. On the evidence we have, the native option is reasonable in these cases.
compareMeta.nativeEnoughSingle: One WhatsApp number, with no team splitting the conversations.
compareMeta.nativeEnoughInformational: Most of what people ask is answered with information: hours, location, prices, what is available.
compareMeta.nativeEnoughNoOperation: You do not need the conversation to leave a trace in a CRM, in a calendar with several resources, or in a payment.
compareMeta.nativeEnoughNote: If your operation does need that, the comparison stops being about text and becomes about which system is up to date when the conversation ends. That is where we suggest you evaluate us.
compareMeta.refutedTitle: What you will not read on this page
compareMeta.refutedIntro: These lines circulate in market comparisons. We checked them against Meta's sources and dropped them.
compareMeta.refutedMetaOnlyFaq: “Meta only answers fixed questions.” False: its documentation describes learning, tone and correction.
compareMeta.refutedMetaNoBooking: “Meta does not book or follow up.” False as a general statement: there is documentation and published cases.
compareMeta.refutedMetaWhatsappOnly: “Meta only works for WhatsApp.” False: Messenger and Instagram are in its official scope.
compareMeta.refutedCheaper: “Parallly always costs less.” Not demonstrated: comparing a free app with an API's token price would be wrong.
compareMeta.refutedNoDataToMeta: “With Parallly your data never reaches Meta or AI providers.” We will not stand behind that without a precise scope for every flow.
compareMeta.sourcesIntro: All of them are public Meta pages, consulted on 10 September 2026. Several show no edit date; where they do, we say so.
compareMeta.sourcesExternal: Opens a Meta site in a new tab.
compareMeta.ctaBody: The useful way to decide is to look at which task of yours has to be finished when the conversation ends. The plans and their limits are published.

quality.name: Quality Center
quality.summary: Separates preparation, testing and production evidence. Review signals for the agent and its version to prioritize informed changes.
quality.title: Improve your agent with evidence and human review.
quality.description: Identify what remains to prepare, what has been tested and what is observed in service. Use these signals and guidance from Parallly Assist to decide the next change.

quality.benefit1Text: Review requirements, scope, sources, connections and conditions for working with the agent.
quality.benefit2Text: Interpret results alongside their version, date and scenarios; a change can make earlier evidence outdated.

operations.name: Operations and team
operations.title: Bring the conversation into daily work.
operations.description: Coordinate scheduling, requests and your team within the scope enabled for your business. Specialized features have their own availability.

intelligence.name: Intelligence and guidance
intelligence.title: Prepare information. Guide your team. Review quality.
intelligence.description: The agent talks with customers. Sources inform it. Assist guides the team and Quality helps prioritize reviews.

visibility.name: Visibility
visibility.title: Review activity and maintain continuity.
visibility.description: See what is happening in service and let the team continue available tasks across their work surfaces.

channels.name: Channels and a shared inbox
channels.description: WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram and Web Chat, with the connections enabled for your business.

agent.name: Configurable AI agents
agent.description: Information, rules and tools for customer conversations, with guided preparation and reviewed publication.

crm.name: CRM and commercial follow-up
crm.description: Contacts, opportunities, stages and tasks to organize what comes next in each relationship.

booking.name: Appointments and scheduling
booking.description: Services, availability and calendars to coordinate appointments from conversations.

payments.name: Orders and customer payments
payments.description: Commercial operations according to enabled capabilities. Links use the business's own gateway; issuing a link does not confirm payment.
payments.details: Review and organize the orders available for your operation. When customer payments are enabled and your provider is ready, links use your Wompi or Mercado Pago account. The provider's state confirms payment; the agent does not choose the amount, and those credentials do not pay your Parallly subscription.

team.name: Teamwork
team.description: Inbox, assignment and human handoff with context. Each role accesses the tasks it is authorized to perform.
team.details: The administrator prepares agents and connections; the supervisor reviews quality and coordinates follow-up; the human agent handles authorized conversations and tasks. The inbox supports continuing a handoff with context and using AI suggestions or summaries within authorized conversations.

knowledge.name: Knowledge base
knowledge.description: FAQs, documents and articles that complement the business catalog and policies.

assist.name: Parallly Assist
assist.description: Internal help to understand features, prepare setup and find the next authorized step.

quality.name: Quality Center
quality.description: Preparation, tests and production evidence to review what needs attention.

analytics.name: Service analytics
analytics.description: Available activity, timing and outcomes to review operations. Metrics need data and sufficient scope.
analytics.details: Review conversation volume, service times and channel activity over available periods. Use AI and team data to identify what merits follow-up. Missing data or a small sample limits conclusions; it does not amount to a positive result.

mobile.name: Android app
mobile.description: An operational companion for the team, available on Google Play, with conversations and tasks according to role.

platformHub.exampleTitle: You don't need to know every screen to take the first step.
platformHub.exampleDescription: Ask Parallly Assist where to prepare information or what to review before publishing. Guidance changes with each person's responsibilities.

crm.tryMove: Move the opportunity and see its profile update.
crm.handoffDescription: Laura asked to speak to someone. The team receives the conversation, reason for contact and history to continue.
crm.historyHandoff: Handed to a person with its context.
crm.localOnly: Changes apply only to this example. They do not create contacts, tasks or pipeline changes in a real account.
crm.title: Your customers' interest
crm.description: Organize contacts, opportunities and tasks alongside their conversations. Your team sees what each customer needs, who owns the case and what remains to do.
crm.note: CRM built into Parallly. Configure the process and permissions your team needs.
crm.previewMessage: I'm interested in a consultation for my business.
crm.previewTeam: The inquiry and next step stay in view.
crm.demoHeading: Move an opportunity. See everything that travels with it.
crm.demoDescription: Move the example through stages, change its owner or complete a task. The profile and history reflect the same opportunity.
crm.featuresTitle: Make follow-up a process, not a memory test.
crm.featuresDescription: Give your team tools to organize work, segment contacts and review sales progress.
crm.feature1Description: Contacts, tags, notes and activity to understand each customer relationship.
crm.feature2Description: Configure stages around your process and assign tasks to keep the next step visible.
crm.feature3Description: Group contacts by criteria and use configured rules to support follow-up, depending on your plan's features.
crm.feature4Description: Review the funnel, sources and sales performance to identify where follow-up needs attention.
crm.rolesTitle: Every opportunity has a team behind it.
crm.rolesDescription: Organize responsibilities and access so people collaborate with the same context.

role.admin: Defines the process, fields and team access configuration.
role.supervisor: Reviews the pipeline, coordinates owners and supervises follow-up and permitted indicators.
role.agent: Works on permitted contacts and opportunities, records notes and handles assigned tasks.

crm.guideTitle: Set up your process with guidance.
crm.guideDescription: Parallly Assist helps you find the tools and next steps available. Define stages, important data and tasks with your team.
crm.scope: Advanced features, limits and access depend on plan and role. The example does not represent guaranteed sales results.

booking.slotNote: Fictional times. Change the team member to explore another sample schedule.
booking.localOnly: This demonstration does not create an appointment or query real calendars.
booking.title: From an inquiry
booking.description: Define services, staff and availability. Parallly helps guide the conversation toward a booking with the details your team needs.
booking.note: Availability and actions depend on configuration. Test the flow before publishing it on your channel.
booking.previewMessage: Can I book a consultation for my business?
booking.previewDescription: The booking brings the required details together before confirmation.
booking.previewTeam: The team can review and manage permitted appointments.
booking.demoEyebrow: Explore a booking step by step
booking.demoHeading: Availability depends on who is available.
booking.demoDescription: Choose a service and team member, select a sample time and review the summary before simulating confirmation.
booking.featuresEyebrow: Scheduling as part of your operation
booking.featuresTitle: Organize what happens before and after the appointment.
booking.featuresDescription: Bookings connect your service offering, your team's time and customer service.
booking.feature1Description: Duration, format, location and assigned staff give each service its own conditions.
booking.feature2Description: Configure business or staff schedules and block dates your business cannot offer.
booking.feature3Description: Connect Google Calendar or Microsoft according to your setup. Choose a service, staff or general calendar.
booking.feature4Description: Support the process with confirmations, reminders and appointment management, according to enabled channels and features.
booking.rolesDescription: Separate service configuration from daily appointment handling.

role.admin: Configures services, staff, schedules and permitted business integrations.
role.supervisor: Organizes services and availability, and supervises the schedule within their permissions.
role.agent: Views and manages appointments permitted by their role and the booking state.

booking.guideDescription: Parallly Assist guides you to the available configuration. Define services, schedules and staff, test realistic inquiries and review the agent's permitted actions.
booking.scope: Capabilities and calendars depend on your plan, industry and setup. Check which actions each calendar connection supports.

mobile.preview1: I'd like to speak to someone
mobile.contactContext: Details, stage and history to resume the follow-up.
mobile.task3: Confirm the next step with Camila
mobile.taskScope: Real tasks appear according to your account and permissions.
mobile.demoNote: Explore the example tabs. Layout and features depend on the installed version.
mobile.title: Your team stays connected.
mobile.description: Handle conversations and follow contacts, opportunities and tasks with Parallly Mobile. An operational companion to the web, with the access each person needs.
mobile.note: Download the app from Google Play and sign in with your active Parallly account. Access and features follow your team's permissions.
mobile.featuresTitle: Keep the context you need close at hand.
mobile.featuresDescription: The app supports daily work. Full business, agent, channel and billing configuration stays on the web.
mobile.feature1Description: View conversations, take permitted cases, add notes and continue with the history.
mobile.feature2Description: Request suggestions, tone adjustments or summaries in supported conversations.
mobile.feature3Description: View contact profiles, move opportunities through permitted stages and review assigned tasks.
mobile.feature4Description: Access scheduling or other operations when published and enabled for your industry, account and role.
mobile.rolesTitle: Same team. Access that fits each role.
mobile.rolesDescription: Account permissions apply on mobile too; the app does not extend access when away from the office.

role.admin: Configures the business, users, agents and channels on the web. Uses mobile for permitted operations.
role.supervisor: Follows customer service, CRM and published operations permitted by their account.
role.agent: Handles cases, views contacts and completes tasks within their permissions and assignments.

mobile.guideTitle: Set up your business on the web.
mobile.guideDescription: Start in the web dashboard with guidance from Parallly Assist. Set up your business and team, then download the app from Google Play and sign in to continue from Android.
mobile.scope: Available for Android on Google Play. Features depend on permissions, your business's enabled capabilities and the installed version.

channels.title: Your customers are already talking.
channels.accent: Give your team one place to respond.
channels.description: Connect your business channels with guided setup. AI responds using your sources, and your team continues the conversation when a person is needed.
channels.note: Parallly Assist guides you. Provider permissions and agent publication are reviewed separately.
channels.previewDescription: Conversations connected to the AI and people serving your business.
channels.previewTeam: History and reason for contact available when stepping in.
channels.featuresDescription: Bring customer service together with your business's sales and operational context.
channels.feature1Description: Configure services, FAQs and policies so the agent can consult your business information.
channels.feature2Description: Your team can take over, review the history and continue from the inbox within their permissions.
channels.feature3Description: Choose which agent handles each operational connection. Agent and connection capacity depends on the current plan.
channels.feature4Description: Connect the conversation with contacts, opportunities and tasks to organize what comes next.
channels.rolesTitle: A connected team with clear responsibilities.
channels.rolesDescription: Everyone participates according to their role, with separate responsibilities for setup and service.

role.admin: Connects accounts, authorizes provider permissions and configures the agent to publish for each connection.
role.supervisor: Organizes and supervises the team's service within their operational access.
role.agent: Handles permitted conversations, keeps notes and hands over cases with context.

channels.guideTitle: Connect with guidance at your side.
channels.guideDescription: Parallly Assist guides you through the steps and requirements available for your business. You authorize accounts, test responses and publish the approved agent version.
channels.scope: Channels, agents and features depend on plan, role and setup. A technical connection is not end-to-end certification.

channelExperience.title: Choose a channel. See how it works with you.
channelExperience.description: Review each channel's setup and step through a service example. Parallly Assist guides you through the steps available for your business.
channelExperience.agentReply: We can explain our services and help arrange a consultation. What do you need help with?
channelExperience.handoffRequest: I'd prefer to speak to someone on your team.
channelExperience.handoffDescription: Conversation, history and reason for contact available to the person taking over.
channelExperience.stepHint: Continue to see the example reply and handoff to a person.
channelExperience.chooseStep: Choose a step in the example conversation
channelExperience.publishTitle: Connecting the channel is the beginning.
channelExperience.publishDescription: Then configure and test the agent, prepare and approve its version, and publish it on the chosen connection. A technical connection alone does not activate AI replies.
channelExperience.assistLink: See how Parallly Assist guides you
channelExperience.scope: Features depend on plan, permissions and setup. Illustrative example; no messages are sent and no real accounts are connected.

whatsapp.title: Your WhatsApp, connected to your operation.
whatsapp.description: Bring inquiries from your business number together with AI, follow-up and your team's support.
whatsapp.step1: Review the available path for your number and your business account requirements.
whatsapp.step2: Open Meta's flow from Parallly and authorize the account, number and requested permissions.
whatsapp.step3: Review the connection status and prepare a test with the agent you will publish.
whatsapp.requirement: The connection path depends on the number and its eligibility. Meta's templates, service windows and charges still apply.
whatsapp.message: Hi, what services do you offer for businesses?

instagram.title: From a direct message to organized service.
instagram.description: Bring business account messages into the inbox to respond and follow up with context.
instagram.step1: Prepare your Instagram Business account and authorized management access.
instagram.step2: Select Connect Instagram and sign in through the authorization window.
instagram.step3: Authorize messaging permissions and review the connected account before testing your agent.
instagram.requirement: Requires a compatible business account and current permissions. Authorization may need renewal; a personal account is not a business connection.
instagram.message: I saw your services on Instagram. Can you help me?

messenger.title: Your Facebook Page, closer to your customers.
messenger.description: Receive your Page's messages where your team handles support and records follow-ups.
messenger.step1: Make sure you have access to manage your business's Facebook Page.
messenger.step2: Open Connect Messenger and authorize access through Facebook Login.
messenger.step3: Authorize the Page and messaging permissions, then review which Page was connected.
messenger.requirement: The connection is for a Page, not a personal profile. Access and message delivery are subject to Meta's permissions and rules.
messenger.message: Hi, I found your Page and would like to learn more.

telegram.title: A Telegram bot with business context.
telegram.description: Connect your bot to bring its conversations together with your AI agent and team.
telegram.step1: Create or prepare your bot in BotFather and get its token.
telegram.step2: Enter the token in your business's Telegram settings in Parallly.
telegram.step3: Parallly configures the bot's message reception; review the status and test the conversation.
telegram.requirement: Configure the token in the authenticated dashboard, never in this demonstration. Use a bot your business is authorized to manage.
telegram.message: Hi, I'd like to ask about your services through this bot.

web.title: Your website can start the conversation too.
web.description: Offer a point of contact on your website and bring inquiries into your business's service workspace.
web.step1: Create the Web Chat in Channels and integrations in your business dashboard.
web.step2: Customize the appearance, greeting and authorized domains.
web.step3: Copy the installation code into your website and test the chat from an allowed domain.
web.requirement: You need access to edit your website or help from its administrator. Widget setup and agent publication are separate steps.
web.message: I'm on your website. Can you help me choose a service?

mobileAppShowcase.title: Your team on the move.
mobileAppShowcase.description: Keep helping customers and following up from your phone. Take your business conversations, contacts and schedule with you.
mobileAppShowcase.downloadLabel: Download Parallly on Google Play (opens a new tab)
mobileAppShowcase.accountNote: Sign in with your Parallly account. Initial setup takes place on the web; available features depend on your role and plan.

subscriptionPayment.providerUnknown: Wompi in Colombia and Stripe outside Colombia
subscriptionPayment.body: Your subscription covers the platform and your plan’s AI capacity. {provider} processes the payment; Parallly does not store full card details or security codes. Availability is confirmed when you select a plan.
subscriptionPayment.security: Each business has isolated data and access protected by authentication and roles. {provider} processes subscription payments. See the privacy policy for details on data handling.
subscriptionPayment.metaSeparation: No. {provider} only processes your Parallly subscription. Meta’s payment method is configured and held by Meta. Payments from your customers use your business’s own credentials.

countryHint.wompi: Colombia: subscriptions through Wompi in COP. Colombian electronic invoicing is managed separately in Fiscal billing.
countryHint.stripe: Outside Colombia: subscriptions through Stripe in USD. Signup does not request a Colombian DIAN profile. Confirm your billing country before continuing.
countryHint.unknown: Select your country to see prices: Wompi in Colombia and Stripe in the other available countries. Your browser language does not determine your country.
